description: Runs a Cognigy.AI playbook test scenario against a flow. MUTATING: This executes test assertions. Use dryRun=true (default) to validate first. Returns pass/fail results with assertion details.

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without running. Set to false to actually run the playbook.

entrypoint.description: The snapshot or project ID to run against

flowId.description: The reference ID of the flow to test

localeId.description: The reference ID of the locale

pollIntervalMs.description: How often to check task status (1-10 seconds, default 3)

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for playbook completion (5-300 seconds, default 120)

name: run_playbook
